details.description: Qwen3-Coder-Next is Qwen's coding-focused model built on the Qwen3-Next hybrid architecture, combining Gated DeltaNet and gated-attention layers across 48 layers, with 80 billion total parameters and 3 billion activated per token (512 experts, 10 active). Qwen's model card describes it as achieving performance comparable to models with 10-20x more active parameters on agentic coding tasks, including long-horizon reasoning, complex tool usage, and recovery from execution failures. It has a native 262,144-token context window, runs in non-thinking mode only, and integrates with IDE agent tools such as Claude Code, Qwen Code, and Cline. Amazon Bedrock lists it as 'Qwen3 Coder Next' (model ID qwen.qwen3-coder-next), launched there February 4, 2026.
advantages: Scores 70.6 on SWE-bench Verified, a software-engineering benchmark (Qwen's model card).
Scores 44.3 on SWE-bench Pro (Qwen's model card).
Qwen describes it as achieving performance 'comparable to models with 10-20x more active parameters' while using only 3B active parameters per token.
Integrates with Claude Code, Qwen Code, and Cline for IDE-based agentic coding.
Uses a hybrid Gated DeltaNet and Gated Attention architecture aimed at efficient long-horizon agentic tasks (Qwen's model card).
disadvantages: Non-thinking mode only; does not generate <think></think> reasoning blocks (Qwen's model card).
use_cases: Long-horizon agentic coding tasks requiring multi-step tool usage
Recovering from execution failures during autonomous coding runs
IDE-integrated coding agents (Claude Code, Qwen Code, Cline)
Local development workflows with a coding-focused open-weight model

sources.title: Qwen — Qwen3 Coder Next - Amazon Bedrock User Guide

notes: Amazon Bedrock's EULA link for this exact model ID points to the Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct license page rather than a Qwen3-Coder-Next-specific one; treated as a likely documentation artifact on AWS's page, not evidence the two are the same model. Facts list two max_input (256000/262144) and max_output (8192/16000) values, reflecting variation across the many regional Bedrock URIs in this group; AWS's current model card states 256K context / 16K max output for the in-region endpoints it lists (us-east-1, eu-west-2, ap-southeast-2), consistent with the larger of each pair. The catalog's 12 listed URIs span more regions than AWS's model card currently shows as in-region available; not investigated further, per instructions, since routes/regions are out of scope here.
